issues.reason: The genitive rule explicitly excludes a measure / container of-phrase ("a cup of water") from Possession, and since Possession is possessed-first the emitted atom additionally says the mire-essence owns the vessel - a possessor link the text does not state.

gaps_confirmed: container/contents (or material) of-phrase on a concrete noun ("the vessel of mire-essence") - Possession is barred by the measure/container exclusion and the entity-attached (Of ...) oblique is licensed only for a nominalization's object, so no head is licensed
defect_summary: No compliant form is licensed for "the vessel of mire-essence" - Possession is barred by the measure/container exclusion, PartOf would be false (contents are not a component of their container), and the entity-attached (Of ...) oblique is licensed only for a nominalization's object - so the compliant parse types the vessel, fills its Theme slot, and leaves the of-phrase unencoded as a recorded gap, on the "D-Ashford has no licensed head" precedent.
notes: Everything else follows the instruction set: "each Council member" as the per-member (PartOf $x sk_council_1) rule at 1.0 / 0.9 with a group-kind QuantifierPhrase and no group event beside it, no Name atom for the capitalized bare-class label "Council", mire_essence's noun modifier unexposed with the essence genus emitted, and the temporal-anchor event-noun carrying only its class atom, its Ordinal restrictor and the Before link inside the consequent.
